data.subject: The Whip's Weekly Preview: Friday, November 27, 2026
data.weekAheadText:
Monday, November 30, 2026
On Monday, the House will meet at 12:00 p.m. for Morning Hour debate and 2:00 p.m. for legislative business, with votes postponed until 6:30 p.m.

Suspensions (12 bills)

  1. S. 4631 – Expanding Whistleblower Protections for Contractors Act of 2026, as amended (Sen. Peters – Oversight and Government Reform)
  2. S. 921 – Tyler’s Law, as amended (Sen. Banks – Energy and Commerce)
  3. S. 1157 – Women and Lung Cancer Research and Preventive Services Act of 2025 (Sen. Smith – Energy and Commerce)
  4. S. 494 – National Plan for Epilepsy Act (Sen. Schmitt – Energy and Commerce)
  5. H.R. 1669 – To amend the Public Health Service Act to reauthorize the Stop, Observe, Ask, and Respond to Health and Wellness Training Program, as amended (Rep. Cohen – Energy and Commerce)
  6. Senate Amendment to H.R. 1520 – Charlotte Woodward Organ Transplant Discrimination Prevention Act (Rep. Cammack – Energy and Commerce)
  7. H.R. 2332 – SHARE Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Mann – Education and Workforce)
  8. S. 3296 – Improving Access to Workers’ Compensation for Injured Federal Workers Act of 2025 (Sen. Collins – Education and Workforce)
  9. Senate Amendment to H.R. 4624 – Muhammad Ali American Boxing Revival Act of 2026 (Rep. Jack – Education and Workforce)
  10. S. 4394 – Promoting Police Leadership Act (Sen. Cornyn – Judiciary)
  11. H.R. 3100 – CHILD Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Fry – Judiciary)
  12. S. 4850 – Diversity Jurisdiction Inflation Adjustment Act (Sen. Kennedy – Judiciary)

Tuesday, December 1, 2026 and the Balance of the Week
On Tuesday and Wednesday, the House will meet at 10:00 a.m. for Morning Hour and 12:00 p.m. for legislative business. On Thursday, the House will meet at 9:00 a.m. for legislative business, with last votes expected no later than 3:00 p.m.

Suspensions (7 bills)

  1. H.R. 9503 – Officer Leslie Coffelt U.S. Secret Service Police Act, as amended (Rep. Rutherford – Judiciary)
  2. S. 162 – Recruiting Families Using Data Act of 2025 (Sen. Grassley – Ways and Means)
  3. H.R. 3514 – Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act of 2026, as amended (Rep. Kelly (PA) – Ways and Means)
  4. S. 645 – North Platte Canteen Congressional Gold Medal Act (Sen. Fischer – Financial Services)
  5. H.R. 4382 – America’s Olympic and Paralympic Games Commemorative Coins Act (Rep. Sherman – Financial Services)
  6. H.R. 1628 – 761st Tank Battalion Congressional Gold Medal Act, as amended (Rep. Palmer – Financial Services)
  7. H.R. 4449 – Advocating for Small Business Act, as amended (Rep. Gonzalez – Financial Services)

Senate Amendment to H.R. 2347 – Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 (Rep. Smucker – Natural Resources) (Subject to a Rule)
